name: Procure to Pay
description: Chuoi quy trinh mua sam den thanh toan theo AS-IS va TO-BE.
author: Core Team

items.name: Request Purchase
items.steps: User creates request, manager reviews, procurement receives request

items.name: Vendor Quotation
items.steps: Procurement requests quotation, vendors respond, shortlist is created

items.name: PO Approval
items.steps: Purchase order drafted, finance checks budget, approver signs off

items.name: Goods Receipt
items.steps: Warehouse confirms receipt, system auto-matches PO, discrepancies escalated

items.name: Invoice Matching
items.steps: 3-way match is executed, exceptions routed, payment batch prepared
